additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453130-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R8 170002544 ] Charger interrupts charging process CRM:02678000461
additional_info.body:
Good morning Mr. Grossmann,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0453130.
The ticket was opened for a failed charging session o 29.09.2025 at 08:37 on charger
MP / R8 170002544.
I analyzed the logs on SCB and these are my findings:
DC1 starts charging at
2025-09-29T05:54:18
UTC time with EVMAC":"00.18.23.bd.50.7a"
DC2 starts charging at 2025-09-29T06:15:32
After few seconds, at 2025-09-29T06:15:45 DC1 stops its charging session. Stop of the charging session comes from the EV:
2025-09-29T06:17:28.000000+00:00 [FW080005G1] secc-le [daemon:notice] SECC[834]: {"type":"stop_charging","timestamp":1759126648938,"chargerId":"secc2300-10711","outlet":"1","outletType":"CCS","payload":
{"source":"EV",
"user":"internal"}
There is no error message in the logs form charger side.
It seems to be a clear charging interruption as per requested by the EV.
Hope my analysis provides with an explanation. Please let me know if you need further support, otherwise I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
eMobility Service Delivery
Expert Services
SI E CS SD ES
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com

Thank you.
